source.title: Mtaala wa Shule ya Junia - Kiswahili - Gredi ya 8 (Toleo la Kwanza 2023, Iliyorekebishwa 2024)
source.publisher: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development (KICD) — mirrored via teacherspalace.co.ke
source.notes: Follow-up verification pass confirmed this is genuinely the current 2024-revised design, superseding the previously-cited teacher.co.ke mirror (which was a 2022 first-edition draft copy of the same document). This teacherspalace.co.ke file matches the exact filename pattern KICD's own Google Drive index shows for this subject ('Kiswahili Grade 8 - July 2024 - Revised Oct'). Its title page reads 'TAASISI YA UKUZAJI MITAALA KENYA / MTAALA WA SHULE YA JUNIA / KISWAHILI / GREDI YA NANE', states 'Toleo la Kwanza 2023 / Iliyorekebishwa 2024' (First Edition 2023, Revised 2024), and carries the SAME ISBN (978-9914-43-796-6) as the earlier-cited 2022-draft mirror -- confirming both are the same underlying KICD document, with this copy being the later-dated, revised printing. The foreword (DIBAJI YA WAZIRI WA ELIMU) is signed by the current Cabinet Secretary MHE. EZEKIEL OMBAKI MACHOGU, matching the pattern of other confirmed-2024-revised Grade 8 designs (French, German, Mandarin, CRE). Full text was read verbatim via the Read tool (not AI-summarized). Strand/sub-strand structure (15 themes x 4 language-skill strands = 60 sub-strands: Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza, Kusoma, Kuandika, Sarufi) matches exactly what was already transcribed from the 2022-draft mirror, confirming that revision pass did not restructure the curriculum -- the previously-recorded strand content below is retained as-is since spot-checking the theme titles, sub-strand names, and lesson-count table (MUHTASARI WA MADA NA MADA NDOGO) against this confirmed-current copy showed no differences. The design's own MGAO WA VIPINDI (lesson allocation) table labels the subject slot 'Kiswahili/KSL' (Kenya Sign Language sharing the same lesson allocation slot), but the design content itself is pure Kiswahili with no distinct KSL curriculum content found in the document body.
